verdict.rationale: The Gmail API covers the core mailbox operations a user does in the UI: sending messages, push notifications on mailbox changes, filters and labels, delegates, and read and backup access. A community report says the API is far better suited than IMAP to replicating the Gmail interface. However, several UI features (snooze, undo send, offline mode, Gemini summarize/draft/organize, suggested replies) have no evidence of API equivalents, so full UI parity is not shown. Missing for 10: API evidence for snooze, undo/cancel send, Gemini AI actions, suggested replies and offline features, plus any first-party statement or independent verification of complete UI–API parity.
